integrity.accepted_theorem: 9828 size-eight sets; every one has four point and four line vertices; four full symmetry orbits of sizes 936, 1404, 1872, 5616.
integrity.method: Exhaustive exact C++17 search, independent Python incidence-signature search, full projective group closure and orbit enumeration.

scientific_limitations: Finite result only; metric dimension eight itself is already known.
Reproducibility depends on complete finite enumeration and exact integer combinatorics; independent external audit not performed.
scientific_scope: Exact enumeration and full projective incidence-symmetry classification of minimum resolving sets of the 26-vertex incidence graph of PG(2,3).
title: Four projective symmetry types of minimum resolving sets in the ternary projective plane
